rationale: Keene Ridge Farm is a professional boarding and retirement facility on 170 acres in Lexington, KY. Owner Ann Bakhaus operates multiple barns (A, B, C) with full board at $775, pasture board at $450, and mare retirement at $450. The facility includes indoor/outdoor arenas, 20+ fields, and offers boarding, retirement, riding lessons and clinics. Blacksmith and vet services are scheduled routinely. The operation serves multiple horses clearly exceeding 3 head, across multiple disciplines and breeds (Thoroughbreds, Shires, Paints, Warmbloods, etc.). The official website self-presents as the farm's own site with owner name, full address, contact email, detailed pricing and services, and boarder testimonials.
